result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback because affiliates are covered without even requiring notice and assignment to an M&A successor is permitted. It does not reach the preferred position: there is no perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, and subscription rights may still end through non-renewal, Section 12, or Section 13(a), rather than solely for an uncured material breach. The assignment exception also unnecessarily gives TrueLink the same expanded successor-transfer right, altering the supplier-assignment bargain. The margin comment overstates the termination protection because Section 13(a) remains operative.
